validation.rootTestsNote: Isolated host-root run: DSH_CONTROLS_HOST_ROOT plus the checksum-bound accepted tarball, so no environment-gated host integration case was skipped. A plain node --test without that host seam reports 773 cases with 286 environment-gated skips.
validation.featureEvidence: The plugin ran the same projection pipeline on every step and every tool result. DSH core evidence shows agent/pre-step precedes every step-opening request, including the one after each tool batch, and that tools/post-execute contexts are only ferried through the next pre-step claim, so the per-tool rebuild was redundant for freshness. A refresh gate now watches the revisions the projection derives from and reuses the verified projection while they are unchanged, keeping the per-call delivery decision (an undelivered snapshot is still re-offered, a degraded cache still re-reads). Measured before the change: 41 projections in 30 s of working time, 32 of them from tools that cannot change instrument state.
validation.privacy: Only six closed assets published; no local raw logs, profile snapshots or session evidence
